note: Live sites crawled on a schedule so a crawlkit change that moves findings on a real site is measured rather than noticed. Counts are compared against the last committed baseline; deltas are reported, and only a site that crawls to zero pages fails the run. `pages` caps the crawl: these are trend signals, not audits, and a stable cap keeps the counts comparable.
